title: Rank FNDDS survey foods by one nutrient (October 2020)
purpose: Rank the FNDDS survey foods in this FoodData Central release by their amount per 100 g of one nutrient, highest or lowest first, with each food's FDC id, food code, description, WWEIA category, the nutrient's name and unit and the amount. Foods without a published amount for the nutrient are left out. Ties order by description, then FDC id. Each food and nutrient pair has one amount in this release.

parameters.name: nutrient_id
parameters.description: Nutrient id in this release (fdc-fndds-food-nutrients-2020-10 lists them, for example 1003 protein or 1162 vitamin C)

output_columns.name: fdc_id
output_columns.description: FoodData Central id of the food

output_columns.name: wweia_category
output_columns.description: WWEIA food category description as published

output_columns.name: amount
output_columns.description: Amount per 100 g of the food, as published
